newsitem.title: USA: Coach USA says acquires 5 businesses.
newsitem.headline: Coach USA says acquires 5 businesses.

text.p: Coach USA Inc said Tuesday it acquired five motorcoach and passenger ground transportation businesses with annual revenues of $40 million.
The purchase price was not disclosed.
The company said these acquisitions bring the total revenues acquired during the second quarter of 1997 to $89 million and increase the revenue run rate of Coach USA to over $450 million.

The businesses include Arrow Line Inc of Hartford, Connecticut; the business of Gray Line of Dallas-Ft. Worth and Austin, Texas; Metro Transportation Services of Miami, Florida; Metro Taxi Inc of Denver, Colorado; and Diamond Bus Lines of Little Rock, Arkansas.
The Gray Line businesses in Dallas-Ft. Worth and Austin, Diamond Bus Lines and Metro Taxi will be accounted for as purchases.
The acquisition of Metro Taxi has received preliminary regulatory approval and final approval is pending.
Arrow Line and Metro Transportation Services, which have annual revenues of $25 million, will be accounted for as poolings-of-interests.
